research_notes: Ownership pass 2026-10-20: Drafted 2026-10-20 by automated research; sources as listed. legal_name filled from CRTA decisions of 2019-2020, which describe ALPHA Κύπρου as owned by the company 'ALPHA TELEVISION CYPRUS LIMITED'. EurOMo (Dec 2025) gives the same entity, so the name is probably still current, but confirm it and the HE number in the Registrar of Companies (info-clipper.com shows the company at 5 Arch. Kyprianou, Latsia 2235, with no number). Shareholders not recorded. Parapolitika.gr (press, 11 Apr 2018) reported that the majority stake held by Dimitris Kontominas and associates of Sokratis Hasikos was sold for EUR 7 million to the X.A. Papaellinas Emporiki Ltd group (AlphaMega supermarkets). The company's own statement then named four new shareholders: Giorgos Theodotou, Christina Dimadi Loizou, Aimilios Mitsigkas and Christoforos Christoforou. The deal was subject to CRTA approval. Euromedia Ownership Monitor (EurOMo), Cyprus country report, Dec 2025 (media-ownership.eu/?p=9595, academic report, finder only, not recorded): Alpha Television Cyprus Ltd 'has X.A. Papaellinas Emporiki Ltd. as a shareholder', with no percentage. These sources are press (2018) or academic, so they go in notes. Motor Oil's 2019 ATHEX announcement (Mediamax Holdings) concerns Alpha Greece, not Alpha Cyprus, so it is not used. An ATHEX 2022 filing that mentioned 'Alpha Television Cyprus' (athexgroup.gr .../874_5089_2022_English_2.pdf) redirected to athens.euronext.com and the fetch was refused. Lead for the verifier: the CRTA 'Έκθεση για την ανάπτυξη της πολυφωνίας και τη συγκέντρωση μετοχών για τα έτη 2017-2022' (June/July 2023, https://crta.org.cy/assets/uploads/pdfs/Ekthesi%20Polyfwnias%202017%20-%202022%2025.7.23.pdf) has a Part IV on shareholdings (pp. 98-183, ownership analysis from p. 114), but the fetch tool only extracted pp. 1-26, so it was not read; its foreword says TV licensees must publish shareholders above 5% in two daily newspapers each January. Even if read, its data would be from 2022-2023 (older than two years). The CRTA 'CRTA REPORT 2024.pdf' could not be fetched (fetch error). Verifier: Registrar of Companies shareholders of ALPHA TELEVISION CYPRUS LIMITED, and the CRTA shareholding report. Earlier pass: Drafted 2026-10-16 by automated research; sources as listed. Licensee legal name and owners not found (the 2009 CRTA decision gives only the trading name). The undated government list (uploaded Aug 2020) shows Alpha TV at 5 Arch.
